seeds.title: Ruined Portal at Spawn Shore
seeds.description: Community submission from GitHub issue #1. The reported Java 1.20.1 world spawns with a ruined portal visible near the shore and water; the local structure oracle confirms a ruined portal candidate at X=0, Z=80, 6 blocks from the submitted coordinates X=4, Y=65, Z=76.

seeds.title: Spawner Cluster and Notch Apple Chest
seeds.description: Community submission from GitHub issue #2 for Bedrock 26.13. Reported as lots of spawners in close proximity plus two touching chests with a notch apple in one chest. The app verifies the seed/version parse and Snowy Taiga biome at the submitted coordinates; dungeon spawner and chest loot placement still need manual in-game confirmation.

seeds.title: Minecraft Education Desert Temple Village House
seeds.description: Email submission for Minecraft Education. The 2/21/2026 Education client corresponds to Education 1.21.132; the local Bedrock-family generator confirms a desert biome at X=170, Y=73, Z=1298 and a nearby desert pyramid terrain candidate at X=128, Z=1152. The reported village house inside the desert temple still needs manual Education Edition verification.

seeds.title: Weird Looking Spikey Mountain
seeds.description: Community submission from GitHub issue #3 for Java 26.1.2. Reported as an unusual looking spikey mountain in the swamps at X=-208, Y=100, Z=272; visual terrain shape still needs manual in-game confirmation.

seeds.title: Giant Sea Large Biomes Spawn
seeds.description: Community submission from GitHub issue #5. Reported as spawning in the middle of a giant sea on small islands when set to Large Biomes, with total sea range around 400,000 blocks; reported to work from release 1.0 through 1.6.4.
